description: This file defines the class `CellValue`, which is part of the conditional formatting wizard in PhpSpreadsheet. It provides methods to create and manage conditional rules based on cell values, including comparison operators and parsing conditions from existing `Conditional` objects.

classes.name: CellValue
classes.description: A class extending WizardAbstract and implementing WizardInterface, providing methods to define cell value-based conditional formatting rules, including comparison operators and condition parsing.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Creates a condition where the cell's value equals the specified value.

methods.name: notEquals
methods.description: Creates a condition where the cell's value does not equal the specified value.

methods.name: greaterThan
methods.description: Creates a condition where the cell's value is greater than the specified value.

methods.name: greaterThanOrEqual
methods.description: Creates a condition where the cell's value is greater than or equal to the specified value.

methods.name: lessThan
methods.description: Creates a condition where the cell's value is less than the specified value.

methods.name: lessThanOrEqual
methods.description: Creates a condition where the cell's value is less than or equal to the specified value.

methods.name: between
methods.description: Creates a condition where the cell's value is between two specified values.

methods.name: notBetween
methods.description: Creates a condition where the cell's value is not between two specified values.

methods.name: and
methods.description: Adds an additional condition with logical AND, applicable for range operators.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Sets the comparison operator for the condition, e.g., equals, notEquals.

methods.name: operand
methods.description: Sets the operand value(s) for the comparison.

methods.name: getConditional
methods.description: Builds and returns a `Conditional` object representing the configured condition.

methods.name: fromConditional
methods.description: Creates a `CellValue` wizard instance from an existing `Conditional` object.
